title: device-manifest
description: The manifest.json shipped at the root of each Device repo: the static description of one Device (not a Pi-host plugin, and not driver-demo). It is the single source of the static fields; a Device adds its build-stamped version and the Board serial at runtime and publishes the result as Device info (see device-info.schema.json). version and board_serial are FORBIDDEN here so a hand-edited version can never disagree with the release tag. Home Assistant field mapping, for anyone bridging Device info to an HA device block (documented here only; nothing HA-shaped goes on the wire): product -> model, version -> sw_version, board_serial -> serial_number, homepage -> configuration_url, device -> identifiers. board_serial formats seen so far: a Raspberry Pi SoC serial, the Serial line of /proc/cpuinfo (16 hex digits, e.g. 10000000abcdef01; an all-zero or empty value is treated as absent), and an ESP32 MAC address as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Every Device repo's CI validates manifest.json against this schema fetched from the hub repo at a pinned ref; schema/validate-examples.sh fails when an entity schema exists that the publishes enum does not list.

device.description: The Device's key: the topic segment in renewvan/<device>/info and renewvan/<device>/health, and the Home Assistant device identifier. A lowercase slug with no device- prefix (repo renewvan/driver-venus is device 'venus'). The reserved key 'demo' is rejected: it is the Demo namespace root, never a Device.

product.description: Human-readable product name shown as the Device's title (Home Assistant: model).

source.description: What the Device reads: the hardware or feed it senses or remaps (e.g. 'Victron Venus OS MQTT feed', 'ADS1115 resistive sender').

publishes.description: Entity types the Device publishes. A static enum kept in sync with the entity schemas under schema/ by schema/validate-examples.sh: adding an entity schema without listing it here fails that script (in both this schema and device-info.schema.json).

manufacturer.description: Optional. Who makes the Device. Consumers show 'renewvan' when Device info exists without one.

homepage.description: Optional. Project or product URL (Home Assistant: configuration_url).
